newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 18.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

** The newspaper says in a note that the Bundesbank has contested its translation of comments by Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer when it quoted him on Wednesday as saying there was room for interpretation on Maastricht treaty criteria, but that this must be strict.
The Bundesbank gave the following official translation.

"The treaty contains figures on the one hand and besides that also additional verbal qualifications. In the opinion of the Bundesbank and the federal government -- and here the Bundesbank and the federal government agree completely -- those qualifications as well as the numbers must be strictly interpreted and fulfilled."
Le Monde said it stood by its translation, which it said was in line with an interpretation of the treaty by French experts.
-- Russian president Boris Yeltsin dismisses aide and security head Alexander Lebed.

-- Banque Rivaud names as new chairman Groupe Bollore chairman Vincent Bollore, who will tackle the fate of insolvent Air Liberte airline, in which Rivaud holds a 500-million-franc stake. Bank Rivaud supports offer on Air Liberte led by travel group Nouvelles Frontieres.
-- British Airways prepared to inject 440 million francs to save insolvent Air Liberte.

-- Workers at indebted Thomson Multimedia electronics group worry about consequences of planned takeover by Korean conglomerate Daewoo, part of the Lagardere offer for Thomson, fear planned state recapitalisation of Thomson will benefit Daewoo.
